What this test can and cannot show: one model (gpt-6-luna), one run per claim, three workflows with 11 branch conditions, 57 claims (rent increase: 6), mutations written by the same analyst who knows the lint, and 'ordinary' claims that are designed test claims with several true branch flags each. It shows that a condition widened to the general circumstance is read true more often and crosses the threshold; it cannot show detection of subtler, realistic over-breadth, it cannot estimate a false-alarm rate on a real population of ordinary cases, and it does not test a second model.
